gumroad._comment: All four fields are written by the product-creation job (.github/workflows/gumroad-pro-product.yml, agent work through the token the owner already pastes at step 6) - never by hand, and never an owner step. productUrl is the public https URL of the Pro product page; productId is Gumroad's public product id, the one the licence check sends; priceCents and currency are the price Gumroad itself reports when the job reads the product back (minor units: 7900 = 79.00), so the page never shows a price the checkout would not charge. While any of them is empty the Pro button stays disabled and says so, and no price is shown - it never pretends a shop exists. The button is a link; the only request to Gumroad is the licence check from the buyer's browser.

analytics._comment: provider: "none" or "plausible". PostHog moved to its own block below because it is configured cookieless.

posthog._comment: Optional page-view measurement, cookieless. Empty by default: with no projectKey no snippet is emitted and nothing third-party loads. Filling it also needs 'Cookieless server hash mode' enabled in the PostHog project settings - see README.
